# Bryan Markham — bryanmarkham.com

Bryan Markham is an 18-year front-end engineer and digital strategist based in Raleigh, NC. He diagnoses where DTC stores leak margin: the broken script, the trust gap on the product page, the ad traffic landing on a page that loads in 8 seconds. He ranks every leak by dollar impact and hands founders the fix order.

## The Margin Leak Audit

A complete structural diagnostic of a DTC store. Five to seven days. Every margin leak documented with evidence, priced by impact, and ranked into a fix order the client's team can execute. $2,997. Limited monthly slots.

Guarantee: if the audit fails to identify at least three ranked, actionable margin leaks, the client receives a full refund.

The diagnostic runs in two stages: a proprietary engine trained on Bryan's methodology (machine breadth), followed by Bryan's personal review of every finding (expert judgment). Nothing reaches the report without passing both.

## CitedScore

Bryan also operates CitedScore (citedscore.com), an automated platform that measures how often brands appear in AI-generated responses across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.
